thread:
morgan: Heads-up 1 1 opened a PR to merge duplicate glossary entries and unify phrasebank tags. touches: glossary.yml, style-guide, a couple SDK snippets, and migration notes. pls review when you have a mo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4910
emily: thanks. any changes to voice/tone guidance in this one?
morgan: small ones: prefer 'we' for task steps, avoid commanding 'do X now', and a note about contractions in examples vs warnings. added examples.
pax: SDK impact? i can check python/js snippets.
morgan: JS param-casing change (client now expects snake_case), python has an example model alias swap. i intentionally left the public quickstart aliases intact and added a short deprecation inline comment.
rishi: we should be careful with anchors. i noticed 'inference runtime' -> 'serving runtime' consolidation. will links break?
morgan: added HTML anchor dupes and redirects in glossary.yml for backwards compatibility. updated internal links across docs/* but left user-facing alias text in parentheses where relevant.
docs-bot: preview: docs-site build #4910 available at https://deployments.preview/redwood/docs/4910 :white_check_mark:
sam: can you paste the deprecation blurb so editorial can sanity-check tone?
morgan: sure 1  "Deprecated: model alias `gpt-3` will be removed. Use explicit catalog ids like `rw/gpt-small` for consistent results. See migration notes."
emily: maybe shorter: "Deprecated: `gpt-3`. Use `rw/<model-id>`." keeps it scannable.
lia: editorial note 1 keep contractions allowed in conversational tips but avoid them in security/auth copy. i've flagged that paragraph for review.
pax: JS snippet plan: i'll update examples under /sdk/js but will keep the old alias in the quickstart and add a one-line comment showing the new param names. will open a follow-up PR if needed.
sam: release notes 1 can we add a 1-liner for docs changes? pax or morgan take?
morgan: i'll add a short entry under "docs": "Phrasebank consolidated; glossary duplicates merged; updated SDK snippets and migration notes."
rishi: CI: after merge, schedule docs/regenerate-snapshots and run the linkcheck job. pre-merge linkcheck showed a stale support article which i redirected to support/faq-auth in the PR.
docs-bot: CI queued: linkcheck (#2765432100), regenerate-snapshots (#2765432100)
emily: migration helpers would be handy 1 added sed/grep examples in migration note: e.g. `rg "gpt-3" -l | xargs sed -i "s/gpt-3/rw\/gpt-small/g"` and a psuedo `git`-friendly suggestion.
pax: nice. small nit: show both sed and a macOS-friendly `sed -i ''` variant.
lia: editorial will do a quick pass post-merge, focus on deprecation tone and contraction rules.
morgan: timeline 1 aiming to merge by 6pm PT. tag me if you spot anything blocking.
pax: will finish JS updates by 2pm PT and run local linkcheck.
sam: i'll add the release note stub after merge.
emily: looks good to me. thanks all. :tada:
